devon: Heads-up — main pipeline went red right after the merge. Not seeing an obvious author in the CI summary. Failed job: integration/grpc-chunking-orchestrator (linux-gpu matrix).
ci-bot: [AUTO] Pipeline failed on commit abc1234 (merged by @marco). Failed step: integration/grpc-chunking-orchestrator (exit code 1). Log excerpt: "ERROR: Timeout waiting for server to accept connection". Full logs: https://ci.internal/builds/2333334444
kevin: who owns the grpc chunking infra these days? I can pivot if needed but heads down for 30m.
olivia: I own grpc chunking infra, I can take a quick look.
devon: thanks. can you try a rerun first in case it's transient?
olivia: rerunning the job now.
olivia: ```bash
# rerun via CI tool
ci rerun 2333334444 --job=integration/grpc-chunking-orchestrator
```
ci-bot: Rerun started (build 2333334451). Rerun finished: failed. Same failing step. New log excerpt: "ERROR: failed to bind port 50051: address already in use".
olivia: looks like a port bind / leftover process issue rather than pure timeout. digging into worker logs.
kevin: that could be a cleanup regression in the parallel test runner. @marco merged something touching the harness recently, right?
marco: yep, I merged PR 4572 earlier today that touched the test runner's shutdown path. I didn't see flakies locally. Will investigate immediately.
devon: if it's reproducible we should bisect quickly or consider revert + follow-up fix. We want to avoid a long red on main.
olivia: starting a quick local bisect against main~10..main to try and reproduce. Will post findings.
olivia: bisect result: commit 7d9f8b2 (PR 4572, merged by @marco) reproduces the port-bind leftover locally when running the integration suite with --parallel. The runner doesn't kill child processes on fast-path exit.
marco: ack, investigating now. I can open an emergency revert if you confirm CI clears with that.
olivia: opening a revert PR now: redwood/repo#4620 — revert PR 4572.
olivia: triggered CI on revert branch.
ci-bot: Build 2333334702 (revert branch) finished: success. All integration jobs passed.
olivia: revert branch passed end-to-end. Confirming revert fixes the failure. :tada:
marco: thanks, sorry for the disruption — will follow up with a proper fix that ensures child processes are cleaned up and add a regression test for parallel runs.
devon: OK let's merge the revert, then marco can land a targeted fix with tests. Please add the incident note in the oncall doc.
nora: adding to oncall notes and flagging for postmortem / root cause tracking.
devon: appreciate the quick responses. If anyone sees a related flake reappear ping this thread.
